axes.hw: per model: gateway+model TDX, report_data binding, SPKI pin, GPU NRAS; gateway and model TCB reported (tcb:out-of-date shown in red)
axes.code: compose measured into RTMR3 and allowed by NEAR's DstackApp on Base (NEAR's governance; owner is an EOA, no notice period)

composeRegistry.note: NEAR's DstackApp contracts (the app id in each CVM's event log) on Base admit its composes; abalone checks allowedComposeHashes there at one block and refuses if unreachable.

axes.hw: per instance: TDX quote (Intel PCS, TCB UpToDate), report_data binds our nonce with the ML-KEM key the request is sealed to and the evidence certificate's SPKI, MRTD+RTMR0-3 match a row of anchors/chutes_measurements.json, GPU NRAS verdict with its signature checked
axes.code: Chutes' VM image is measured; the chute's serving code that reads the decrypted prompt is not, and nothing binds which model answers (chutesai/chutes#75)

admitted.observer: Chutes' API relays ciphertext only; it sees the account, model, instance, request and reply sizes and timing

peers.note: Gift peers a client admits in /abalone/attest/1, one evidence type per measurement. macrunner: Runner.app CDHash + peer compose hash, verified by lib/vendor/macrunner.mjs. appattest: the probe app (does not cover the peer process; remove once the runner passes). dev: unattested development peers (tests only).

task.note: Task image digests a client accepts in a runner worker's offer (docs/protocols/runner-task.md), compared by digest only: the repository name in the offer never matters. An offer with a local: image is a development process and is shown as one. appId and category: the runner build whose App Attest assertion binds a task VM boot (abalone verify; its CDHashes are macrunner.cdhashes).
